name: FFS_DWH_EXPORT_HIST
description: Stores history of Daily Extract runs.

columns.name: DWH_HISTORY_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier of Daily Extract History record.

columns.name: EXTRACT_DATE
columns.description: Stores a date when daily extract was ran.

columns.name: EXTRACT_TYPE
columns.description: Purpose of extraction: dwh, bics, dbaas, oac.

columns.name: RUN_TYPE
columns.description: Indicates a type of run: Automatic,Manual.

columns.name: USER_ID
columns.description: Who requested dwh manual run (security_user PK).

columns.name: STARTED_AT
columns.description: Stores date and time when extraction was started.

columns.name: FINISHED_AT
columns.description: Stores date and time when extraction was finished.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.
